title.zh: 毛发的数量、尺寸和光学参数
title.en: Counts, sizes and optics of hair

method.zh: 程序化生成头发、眉毛、睫毛时用到的数。每一项注明出处和状态：cited = 打开读过原文或原表；secondary = 只在综述、转引或检索摘要里见到；assumed = 没找到出处，本项目自定。tools/hair/build.ts 读这份表，tests/look-hair.test.ts 拿生成结果和它核对。
method.en: The numbers used to generate scalp hair, eyebrows and eyelashes procedurally. Every item names its source and status: cited = the original text or table was opened and read; secondary = seen only in a review, a quotation or a search snippet; assumed = no source found, this project's own choice. tools/hair/build.ts reads this table and tests/look-hair.test.ts checks the generated grooms against it.

sources.cite: Leerunyakul K, Suchonwanit P. Asian Hair: A Review of Structures, Properties, and Distinctive Disorders. Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol 2020;13:309–318

note.zh: 表 1 汇总了多篇研究（综述，数值是转引）
note.en: Table 1 pools several studies (a review; the values are quoted)

sources.cite: Trichoscopic norms of healthy Thai adults (PMC7035527)

note.zh: 只见到检索摘要中的数值；题目、作者未核对
note.en: Values seen in a search snippet only; title and authors not checked

sources.cite: Bernstein RM. Measurements in Hair Restoration. Hair Transplant Forum Int'l 1998;8(1):27
Flindt R. Amazing Numbers in Biology. Springer 2006, p. 212 (via BioNumbers 101509)
Lasisi T, Ito S, Wakamatsu K, Shaw CN. Quantifying variation in human scalp hair fiber shape and pigmentation. Am J Phys Anthropol 2016

note.zh: 表 2：截面积、最大/最小直径之比、平均曲率（单位按数量级推断为 1/毫米）
note.en: Table 2: cross-sectional area, max/min diameter ratio, mean curvature (unit inferred from magnitude as 1/mm)

sources.cite: Farkas LG anthropometric norms, trichion–nasion of North American whites, quoted in a Kenyan comparison study
Patel BC, Lopez MJ, Joos ZP. Anatomy, Head and Neck: Eyelash. StatPearls 2023 (NBK537278)

note.zh: 经维基百科“Eyelash”条目转引；原页被验证页面挡住
note.en: Quoted through Wikipedia's 'Eyelash' article; the original page sat behind a browser check

sources.cite: Wikipedia, 'Eyelash' (accessed 2026-10), citing Thibaut et al. 2009 Br J Dermatol, Na et al. 2006 Br J Dermatol, Aumond & Bitton 2018 J Optom
Amador GJ, Mao W, DeMercurio P, et al. Eyelashes divert airflow to protect the eye. J R Soc Interface 2015;12:20141294
Pharr M, Jakob W, Humphreys G. Physically Based Rendering, 4th ed., 'Scattering from Hair' (after d'Eon et al. 2011 and Chiang et al. 2016)
Karis B. Physically Based Hair Shading in Unreal. SIGGRAPH 2016 course: Physically Based Shading in Theory and Practice

note.zh: 幻灯片的公式是图片；具体常数按公开的文字说明重新实现，属转引
note.en: The slides' equations are images; the constants were reimplemented from public written descriptions and count as secondary

sources.cite: Dua K, Verma V, Dua A. Beard and Moustache Reconstruction. Indian J Plast Surg 2021;54(4):483–488

note.zh: 按作者观察给出的毛囊单位密度（胡须多为单根单位）
note.en: follicular-unit densities given as the authors' observation (beard units are mostly single hairs)

sources.cite: Marshall WA, Tanner JM. Variations in the pattern of pubertal changes in girls / in boys. Arch Dis Child 1969;44:291–303 and 1970;45:13–23

note.zh: 分期描述只在图里；第 5 期（成人：量与型；女性倒三角，可到大腿内侧）和男性第 6 期（沿白线向上）按二手转述
note.en: the stage descriptions are in the figures; stage 5 (adult in quantity and type; inverted triangle in women, may reach the medial thighs) and the male stage 6 (spread up the linea alba) as paraphrased secondarily

sources.cite: Comparative study of beard and scalp hair. J Soc Cosmet Chem vol. 34 no. 7
Beard growth ≈ 0.27 mm/day (manufacturer page); pubic ≈ 0.3, axillary ≈ 0.4 mm/day (Dermatol Cosmet Med Quir 2026 review, abstract)

note.zh: 颞顶区 133.7 / 其余区约 158 根每平方厘米（泰国人群）
note.en: temporoparietal 133.7 / about 158 hairs/cm² elsewhere (Thai adults)

note.zh: 平均约 2（Bernstein 1998）；1–4 根单位的比例是本项目假设
note.en: mean about 2 (Bernstein 1998); the split into 1–4-hair units is this project's assumption

note.zh: 由截面积换算：d = √(4A/π)，A = 4266 µm²
note.en: from the cross-sectional area: d = √(4A/π), A = 4266 µm²

note.zh: 波纹的波长；与上面的曲率合起来得到振幅 A = κ(λ/2π)² ≈ 4 毫米
note.en: wavelength of the waves; with the curvature above it gives an amplitude A = κ(λ/2π)² ≈ 4 mm

foreheadHeightBySex.unit: mm, vertical rise above the nasion

note.zh: 按竖直高度用（文献是直线距离，额头前倾，直线比竖直长约 2–4 毫米）；取合并均值以下约 0.5–0.8 个标准差，发际线不显得太高
note.en: used as a vertical rise (the literature value is a straight-line distance, and the sloping forehead makes that about 2–4 mm longer than the rise); about 0.5–0.8 SD below the pooled mean, so the hairline does not look too high

lashToEyeWidth.unit: lash length / eye width (22 mammal species)

note.zh: 文献说最多六层；取三层和两层
note.en: up to six layers are reported; three and two are used

note.zh: 只见到无出处的科普数字
note.en: only unsourced popular figures were found

note.zh: 近鼻的毛朝上，上缘的朝外下，下缘的朝外上；以很小的角度出皮肤
note.en: hairs near the nose point upward, those along the top outward and downward, those along the bottom outward and upward; they leave the skin at a shallow angle

note.zh: 男式短发（上长侧短）
note.en: a men's short cut (longer on top, short at the sides)

styleLongLength.unit: mm from the crown; tips cut level about 10 cm below the shoulder line

note.zh: 颈部没有报告，30 是本项目的假设
note.en: no neck value was reported; 30 is this project's assumption

note.zh: 由截面积约 10 700 µm²（转引）换算后取整
note.en: rounded from a cross-section of about 10 700 µm² (quoted)

note.zh: 胡茬约 4–5 天、短须约一个月的生长（按每天 0.27 毫米）；长度本身是本项目的选择
note.en: about 4–5 days of growth for stubble and a month for the short beard (at 0.27 mm a day); the lengths themselves are this project's choice

pubicPattern.male: stage 5 inverted triangle spreading to the medial thighs, plus stage 6 extension up the linea alba
pubicPattern.female: stage 5 inverted triangle with a horizontal upper border
